device_entry.name: Zaber电动位移台
tags: 样品/探针定位与运动控制
device_entry.description: 这是一类通过串口 ASCII 协议控制的精密电动位移设备，通常具有一个或多个运动轴，可执行回零、绝对位移、相对位移和连续运动。它常用于实验室中的样品、光学元件、探针或夹具的精密定位与自动化扫描。
device_entry.description_en: This is a precision motorized positioning device controlled over a serial ASCII protocol, typically with one or more motion axes for homing, absolute moves, relative moves, and continuous motion. It is commonly used in laboratories for precise positioning and automated scanning of samples, optical components, probes, or fixtures.
